title: Bhoos Fantasy
description: UI/UX design for Bhoos Fantasy, a fantasy sports platform covering cricket and football. The project focused on simplifying team selection, player management, powerups, scoring, and tournament progression into a clear and engaging mobile experience.

sections.title: Research & Product Structure
sections.body: I studied competitor patterns, existing user behavior, and the product structure to identify friction points and shape a clearer, more intuitive fantasy sports experience.

images.caption: Competitor Research: Studied existing fantasy sports products to understand common patterns, strengths, and friction points.
User Funnels: Reviewed user activity across key steps to identify drop-offs and engagement patterns.
Information Architecture: Mapped the app’s core sections and flows to create a clearer product structure.

sections.title: A Scalable UI System
sections.body: A flexible design system was created to keep the experience consistent across match states, team-building flows, leaderboards, and seasonal events. Reusable components helped simplify dense sports information while making the interface easier to scale and maintain.

sections.title: Seasonal Tournaments
sections.body: Seasonal tournaments extended the regular match-based experience into limited-time events, where players competed across multiple matches and climbed a separate cumulative leaderboard. Three tournaments were hosted during the app’s run, each giving players a longer-term goal beyond individual match results.
